title: Design System: MC Server Manager Command Studio

headline.purpose: Active server and top-level page identity.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headings, and telemetry labels.

mono.purpose: Commands, paths, ports, timestamps, and measured values only.

shadows.name: floating-overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, menus, and drawers that physically overlap the workbench.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action for the current task.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid #3478f6; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 12px; color: #fff; background: #3478f6; font: 500 13px/20px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #4c8cff; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #72a2ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact supporting action with a quiet structural edge.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid #34435a; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 11px; color: #eef4fb; background: #1b2634; font: 500 13px/20px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #243246; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #72a2ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A compact desktop field placed beneath a visible label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #a3afbd; font: 500 12px/18px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid #34435a; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 11px; color: #eef4fb; background: #090f17; font: 400 13px/20px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #72a2ff; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Server Status
components.description: A stable semantic marker that never reuses interaction blue.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #55c66a; font: 600 12px/18px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: 0 0 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #55c66a; }

components.name: Active Navigation Row
components.description: A compact tonal row with one command-blue active edge.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { width: 220px; min-height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 10px; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #3478f6; color: #eef4fb; background: #1b2634; font: 500 13px/20px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #72a2ff; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Adaptive Splitter
components.description: A pointer- and keyboard-resizable boundary between the active task and contextual operations.
components.css: .ds-splitter { position: relative; width: 7px; cursor: col-resize; background: #0f1620; } .ds-splitter::after { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 3px; width: 1px; content: ""; background: #263142; } .ds-splitter:hover::after, .ds-splitter:focus-visible::after { width: 2px; background: #3478f6; }

narrative.overview: A precise native desktop studio for operating local Minecraft servers. Server identity, health, runtime data, console events, backups, worlds, and content are first-class product objects. The signature composition is an Adaptive Split Workbench with one dominant task and one optional operational context pane.
keyCharacteristics: Nearly flat graphite desktop surfaces with crisp semantic color.
Compact server inventory with unmistakable Minecraft loader identity.
One dominant task canvas plus one optional contextual pane.
Real operational data instead of decorative dashboard metrics.
Full-width work areas with no arbitrary content caps or empty columns.

rules.name: The Independent Signal Rule
rules.body: Interaction blue never means healthy; operational colors never indicate selection.

rules.name: The Incident Rarity Rule
rules.body: Amber and red appear only when the user must notice or act.

rules.name: The Operational Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for content the user may copy, compare, or diagnose.

rules.name: The One Split Rule
rules.body: A workbench may show one persistent vertical split; nested left-right regions inside either side are prohibited.

rules.name: The No Empty Column Rule
rules.body: Space without a current operational purpose returns to the active task canvas.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Persistent surfaces never float, glow, or translate on hover.

dos: Do make the current server, health, and primary action findable within seconds.
Do use real backend values and show unavailable data honestly.
Do let the active task reclaim width when context is closed.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion, dark theme, and light theme.
donts: Don't build pages from equal-sized metric cards or nested panels.
Don't alternate repeated left-right and up-down subdivisions.
Don't leave a permanent empty right column.
Don't imitate Minecraft terrain, inventory chrome, or game HUD decoration.
Don't use gradients, glass, neon glow, oversized typography, or decorative gauges.
